verses.heading: 神的创造

verses.text: <ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>混<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hùn</rt></ruby><ruby>沌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>渊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby>；　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>运<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yùn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>”，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>旱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>露<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lòu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>。　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>青<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>蔬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>包<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>核<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>青<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>蔬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>包<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāo</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>核<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>。　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>岁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>普<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>星<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>普<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>养<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 神跟挪亚立约

verses.text: <ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>昆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kūn</rt></ruby><ruby>虫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>付<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>蔬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>、<ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>讨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>养<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>昌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>繁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>茂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mào</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>谕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>裔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby>、<ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>舟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>绝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>虹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>虹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>虹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby>。”

verses.heading: 挪亚和他的儿子们

verses.text: <ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>裔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>农<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>栽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>醉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>含<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>赤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>闪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>肩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>退<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>奴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nú</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nú</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>闪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>闪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nú</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>扩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuò</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>闪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nú</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>洪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>含<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>麦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mài</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fú</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>腓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>提<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby></mark>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>英<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>勇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>猎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>俗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sú</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>宁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>录<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>英<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>勇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>猎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>甲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>甲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ní</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby><ruby>微<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wēi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>，

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark>！

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！”<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>麦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mài</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>德<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>线<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>鞋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>富<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>！’

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>幔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Màn</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>份<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>任<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>象<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”

verses.text: <mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>革<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby></mark>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>嗣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>嗣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>嗣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>观<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>星<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>裔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>吾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

verses.text: <ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>田<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tián</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>饮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìn</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>饮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìn</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>井<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>鹤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>班<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby>。<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”
