<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>博<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>渡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>，
verses.heading: 雅各在毗努伊勒摔跤

verses.text: <ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>剩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>摔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuāi</rt></ruby><ruby>跤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>黎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby><ruby>摸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>摔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuāi</rt></ruby><ruby>跤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>扭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>黎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>较<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hé</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>毗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pí</rt></ruby><ruby>努<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>伊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark>（<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>”<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>），<ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>刚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>毗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pí</rt></ruby><ruby>努<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>伊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>瘸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qué</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gù</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>摸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>狱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>概<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>察<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>政<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>膳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>，
verses.heading: 约瑟为囚犯解梦

verses.text: <ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>政<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>膳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>府<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>囚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>护<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hù</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>伺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>囚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>政<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>膳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby>做<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chen</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>闷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>囚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>府<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>做<ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby>。”<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>政<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>棵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kē</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，
